measurements.question: 截至观察时刻，你是否出现完整来源列举的睡眠相关困扰？例如难以入睡或保持睡眠、白天难以保持清醒。请按来源完整列表作答；不确定请选择 UNKNOWN。
measurements.construct: Participant report of listed sleep difficulties, not a sleep disorder diagnosis

measurements.question: 截至观察时刻，按你自己的理解，你是否常常觉得睡觉有困难？请注明所指时间范围及你对“常常”的描述；本问卷不设每周次数或周数门槛。
measurements.construct: Source qualitative self-perception of often having trouble sleeping

measurements.question: 截至观察时刻，你是否对自己的睡眠感到困扰或担忧？这是自述，不从研究 Goal 或睡眠均值推断。
measurements.construct: Self-reported sleep concern, source heading scope; not medical urgency

measurements.question: 在你注明的参考时段内，是否在一天较晚的时候摄入含咖啡因饮品？按你对“较晚”的理解作答，可另记时间；不自动设几点以后的门槛。
measurements.construct: Reported caffeine timing behavior; possible habit-action opportunity, not proven cause

unknown_answer_vs_not_collected: ANSWERED/UNKNOWN differs from NOT_COLLECTED/null; neither means NO
qualitative_terms: often/late/concern retain respondent meaning; no numeric conversion or percentile thresholds
source_record_sha256: Hash of separate contemporaneous original questionnaire/interview record, not a circular hash of the import form itself
temporal_rule: reference_start <= reference_end <= reported_at <= as_of; present-day answers cannot backfill historical windows
prospective_sampling: First two eligible episodes of first three genuinely consenting/enrolled participants, enrollment/time order; do not select on symptoms or ratings
retrospective_recall: Retain only in a separately marked secondary collection; not accepted by the primary importer
existing_sleep_duration_mean: Descriptive background only, cannot measure these contexts
